checks.name: hover on a function shows its directive above its visibility
hover on a type shows its visibility
hover on a method shows each directive, a nested argument in full
hover on a method leaves out its language directive and keeps the rest
hover on a method written with no visibility shows the one it has
hover on a method that writes its receiver shows mut &this
hover on a method written `const &this` shows &this
hover on a function writes a pointer to a borrow with the borrow grouped
hover on a function with a named rest writes it `args...`
hover on a C function with a bare rest writes it `...`
hover on a private field shows private
hover on a field written with no visibility shows public
the expanded hover lists members one line each
contains:
private type struct Main::Pair
    left: i32
    right: i32

checks.name: hover on an f-string's text writes each hole's type in it, its spec left out
contains: f"{name: string} is {age: i32} years old {{\n{p.right: i32}" -> String

checks.name: hover inside an f-string's hole still answers the name there
hover on a string literal shows its text and byte count
a string literal's byte count counts a NUL in it
hover on an import path's first segment lists the modules under it
hover on an import path's middle segment shows the path written through it
hover on an import path's last segment still answers its module
the only diagnostic is the unknown directive's
